limitations: Historical 2002–2005 collection; not representative of a modern personal mailbox.
Spam/ham quality does not establish seven-category Inbox Zero quality or authorize mailbox actions.
Later archive additions are a source holdout, not a strict timestamp split.
Classical baseline is local; no claim of an LLM latency comparison.

This experiment was designed after seeing the source-holdout results. It uses independent public labels and group-held-out model evaluation, but is not a new blinded corpus or evidence of robustness to collection shift.
